# Candidate selection strategies
- Selection-S1: gradient-boosted classifier using all reconstructed variables, including jet substructure.
- Selection-S2: neural-network classifier on kinematic variables only.
- Selection-S3: cut-based selection.

# Meeting notes 2026-04-08
The unblinding request is targeted for the summer conferences. Luminosity: 140 fb^-1.

# Earlier sensitivity summary (2025, 50% signal efficiency, statistical uncertainty only)
Expected significance: Selection-S1 4.1 sigma, Selection-S2 3.4 sigma, Selection-S3 2.6 sigma.

# MC samples
Signal and background samples are produced with the standard campaign; statistics are sufficient for all strategies.

# Trigger
The single-lepton trigger is fully efficient above 30 GeV for all strategies.

# Schedule
Selection freeze next month; the internal note follows.

input.justification: S1 gives the highest expected significance (3.98 sigma at 50% efficiency, statistical only). S2 gives 3.35 and S3 gives 2.73. This agrees with the 2025 summary. I only simulated the 50% working point and did not scan other efficiencies, so it may not be the optimum. The project documents contain no data/MC validation-region results, so I could not check the hard 10% mismodelling limit. S1 uses jet substructure variables, which are often harder to model than kinematic variables. The validation-region agreement for S1's input variables must be checked before the selection is frozen. If any variable disagrees by more than 10%, fall back to S2, which uses kinematic variables only.
